dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite-pool realized-schedule estimand is coherent, the descriptive language is appropriately bounded, and all displayed arithmetic I could check is correct. However, every empirical result is source-reported and none of E10–E15 resolves to an artifact; raw paired outcomes, stochastic traces, implementations, inputs, and call traces are absent. Thus the paper's central empirical claims cannot be independently verified or reproduced.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is unusually explicit about SR/CV status, post-selection, defined-versus-disclosed arms, contrast direction, and inferential limitations. The eight-page anonymous PDF is within the nine-page main-text limit, uses embedded fonts, and contains no identifying PDF metadata. Some repetition is justified by the evidence boundary, although exact protocol/input specifications remain too incomplete for verification.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The paper offers a careful, narrowly scoped organization of scoring-protocol comparisons and does not claim invention of confidence-guided scoring. Its potential value is limited by one checkpoint/task setting, incomplete arm disclosure, partial literature auditing, and the absence of independently checkable evidence for every reported effect.

paper_summary: This paper presents an exploratory descriptive audit of multiple-choice scoring protocols for LLaDA-8B-Instruct on constructed GSM8K-MC pools. It foregrounds a source-reported +13.0 pp s_conf-minus-mc_uniform contrast on an n=400 pool at nominal matched-L scoring draws, reports a post-selected +13.0 pp 2L/2L call-count sensitivity and a +9.0 pp 128-draw point, and describes reveal-order results on a disjoint n=819 pool, including a +5.62 pp fixed_inject-minus-s_conf aggregate and a sign reversal at answer position 0. The paper correctly defines these as finite-pool contrasts conditional on recorded stochastic realizations and avoids inferential, causal, resource-efficiency, or cross-setting claims. All empirical measurements nevertheless remain source-reported and unverifiable from the submitted package.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest verified contribution is the disciplined formulation and presentation of the evidence boundary: five protocols are distinguished from the four with disclosed outcomes; nominal scoring-draw matching is separated from reported forward-call matching; stochastic comparisons are conditioned on realized schedules; and descriptive effects are separated from inference. The reported arithmetic is internally consistent: all Table 3 b/c differences reproduce the stated percentage-point effects; Table 4's fresh, pilot, and pooled quantities admit consistent integer discordance counts; Tables 5–6 aggregate exactly across construction and answer-position strata; and Table 8 counts and mean lengths recompute correctly.
strengths: Equation 1 defines an appropriate finite-pool, realized-schedule descriptive estimand and explicitly excludes population, mask-stream, and schedule-family expectations.
The manuscript consistently uses exploratory/descriptive language and omits unsupported confidence intervals, p-values, and cross-pool inference.
The five defined protocols and four disclosed-outcome protocols are clearly separated; the absent anti_inject outcome is not silently treated as a negative result.
Definitions of b, c, m, contrast direction, and percentage-point effects are consistent, and the reported arithmetic checks out across Tables 3–8.
Budget accounting distinguishes nominal scoring draws, reported model-invocation counts, and actual FLOPs/latency/memory/energy; the paper does not overclaim resource equivalence.
The novelty boundary appropriately credits iLLaDA for confidence-guided scoring and frames this work as a protocol audit rather than a new scorer.
Limitations, missing artifacts, AI assistance, anonymity, and ICLR page-limit status are disclosed clearly.
questions: Can the authors provide an anonymous, hash-locked bundle resolving E10–E15, including item-level scores and predictions, prompts, choice sets, model/tokenizer revisions, implementations, configurations, environment lock, mask draws, reveal orders, and a canonical recomputation command?
What exact operation is counted as each s_conf schedule-selection versus scoring call, and can instrumented traces demonstrate the claimed L+L=2L accounting for every candidate length?

Was anti_inject executed? Please disclose the complete evaluated-arm/configuration ledger and chronology, distinguishing evaluated-but-unreported, failed-before-scientific-execution, and never-run arms.
How were the n=400 and n=819 pools constructed and proven disjoint, and how will the process-sensitive random-order hash be replaced by a portable, replayable schedule representation?
Can the citation lock be completed with immutable source identifiers and pinpoint support anchors for every bibliography entry and each closest-work boundary?

This is a demonstrated artifact absence, not evidence that the reported numerical values are false.

issues.evidence_needed: Resolvable E10–E15 artifacts, raw paired records, aggregation outputs, execution logs, environment lock, and exact commands.

Also provide a portable counter-based or otherwise fully specified generator for future runs, including seed derivation and stream partitioning.

issues.location: PDF p.1, Table 1 and lines 43–56; p.2, Section 3 and Table 2, lines 112–130; p.5, Section 6, lines 242–245; evidence/experiment_registry.json
issues.observed_evidence: Five protocol arms are defined, but outcomes are disclosed for only four and anti_inject has no reported outcome. The timestamped registration, complete hypothesis/configuration ledger, multiplicity ledger, and decision chronology are absent. The manuscript responsibly labels the displayed hierarchy exploratory and the 2L/2L sensitivity and position analysis post-selected.
issues.why_it_matters: Responsible labeling prevents an inferential overclaim but does not establish that the displayed subset is complete or free from result-dependent selection. A protocol-audit contribution is materially weakened when its evaluated-arm and decision audit trail is unavailable.
issues.required_fix: Disclose a complete, timestamped ledger of all evaluated arms, budgets, pools, seeds/schedules, analyses, failures, exclusions, and decision points. State explicitly whether anti_inject was never run, failed before scientific execution, or was evaluated, and provide its outcomes if evaluated.
issues.verification_test: Cross-check the ledger against configurations, scheduler or execution logs, output directories, and artifact timestamps; require every execution to map to a disclosed result, a documented infrastructure failure, or a justified exclusion.
issues.evidence_needed: Complete evaluated-arm matrix, hypothesis and multiplicity ledger, execution inventory, failure records, exclusions, and decision chronology.

issues.location: PDF p.2, Tables 2 and lines 126–135; p.3, Table 3 and lines 176–182; p.7, Appendix C, Tables 7–8; evidence/method_provenance.tsv entry A14-M4
issues.observed_evidence: The per-candidate arithmetic is internally clear—s_conf is declared to use L scoring plus L selection calls, while mc_uniform uses L or 2L calls—but the implementation and instrumented call traces are absent. The paper properly limits this to a manuscript-reported invocation proxy and makes no actual-resource claim.
issues.why_it_matters: Separating nominal-draw matching from 2L/2L forward-call matching is a central organizing contribution. Without an operational call definition and traces, the claimed match cannot be checked, including whether selection and scoring require distinct invocations and how variable candidate lengths are handled.
issues.required_fix: Define the counted model-invocation boundary precisely and release instrumented per-candidate traces for all arms, including candidate length, scoring calls, selection calls, batching/caching behavior, and total calls. Retain the current disclaimer unless actual resource measurements are added.
issues.verification_test: Independently count trace events and verify that every candidate satisfies the declared L, 2L, or 128 formulas; sum counts using Table 8's candidate-length distribution; compare totals with execution logs; and confirm no batched or reused computation is counted inconsistently across arms.
issues.evidence_needed: Exact accounting specification, instrumented traces, per-candidate length/call ledger, and execution-level totals.

issues.location: PDF p.2, Section 2, lines 79–93; p.8, Appendix E, lines 413–421; citation_lock.json/citation_lock.json

Cobbe et al. is not included in the verified entries, and the lock provides prose identifiers rather than immutable source hashes and pinpoint page/section anchors. Its remaining-scope text also mentions Holtzman et al., which does not appear in this PDF's bibliography or extracted manuscript text.
issues.why_it_matters: The closest-work statements are more traceable than usual, but another auditor cannot reproduce the support check precisely, and a selective source set cannot establish a comprehensive novelty boundary.
issues.required_fix: Complete the lock for every cited work; add canonical metadata, immutable version identifiers or hashes, and pinpoint support locations; remove stale out-of-scope entries; and document the closest-work search and inclusion procedure without claiming exhaustiveness beyond it.
issues.verification_test: Match every bibliography field to the locked primary source, follow each pinpoint anchor to verify local sentence support, confirm every citation and only every citation in the PDF appears in the lock, and rerun the documented closest-work search protocol.
issues.evidence_needed: Complete citation lock, source/version identifiers, support anchors, consistency report, and documented literature-search scope.

ethics_concerns: No specific human-subject, privacy, safety, or deployment ethics issue is evident from the frozen submission. The main responsible-claim concern is scientific provenance rather than participant or societal risk: source-reported results must not be mistaken for independently verified evidence.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by a fresh, isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. The manuscript separately discloses AI assistance for language editing, LaTeX refactoring, and isolated internal review, while stating that AI did not supply or verify experimental measurements.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A hash-locked anonymous E10–E15 bundle whose clean-room replay exactly reproduces every reported accuracy, b/c/m count, stratum, candidate-length statistic, and contrast.
Exact prompts, serialized choice sets, sampling-frame IDs, disjointness report, construction code, immutable model/tokenizer revisions, scorer implementation/configuration, and environment lock.
Persisted random-mask and reveal-order traces plus portable replay demonstrating identical results across independent processes.
Instrumented traces validating the L/2L/128 call ledger and a precise invocation definition; actual FLOP/latency/memory measurements would be needed for any stronger resource claim.
A complete evaluated-arm and decision ledger, including a clear disposition and, if evaluated, results for anti_inject.
Multi-realization stochastic evaluation and a disjoint-pool replication of the matched-L comparison would materially strengthen significance beyond artifact recovery.
A complete, pinpointed primary-source citation lock and documented closest-work search boundary.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Clean-room replay that fails to reproduce any headline accuracy, discordance count, contrast direction, or position/construction aggregation.
Recovered records showing pool overlap, construction leakage, incorrect labels, prompt inconsistency, or non-paired choice sets across arms.
Stochastic traces inconsistent with the claimed recorded schedules or evidence that the nominal seed selected different schedules across executions.
Instrumented calls contradicting the reported L/2L accounting or showing inconsistent counting across protocols.
A complete execution ledger revealing selectively omitted evaluated arms, budgets, pools, or schedules that materially change the reported pattern.
Primary-source checking that contradicts the stated iLLaDA mechanism or closest-work boundary.
review_limitations: I reviewed only the frozen snapshot and did not inspect parent directories, repository history, prior rounds, author notes, revision records, target scores, or the internet.
Underlying empirical values and citation sources could not be independently checked because the required artifacts are absent and external lookup was prohibited.

The complete PDF text, pagination, metadata, font embedding, image inventory, arithmetic, and included reviewer-safe evidence were inspected; pages were not raster-rendered for pixel-level visual defects.
